title: FYI Yachts Hosts the Exclusive Launch of the "Book of RockStar Leaders"
description: FYI Yachts hosted the Book of RockStar Leaders launch aboard Salevita in Coconut Grove, Miami—an elegant evening of champagne, caviar, leaders, and philanthropy.
html:
Miami, FL – FYI Yachts was proud to partner with Zubi Group to host an unforgettable evening celebrating the launch of the Book of RockStar Leaders. Held aboard the elegant 105′ Azimut Salevita in Coconut Grove, the event brought together Miami’s most inspiring leaders, innovators, and visionaries for a champagne and caviar celebration in true South Florida style.

The intimate gathering, set against the stunning backdrop of Biscayne Bay, honored the remarkable individuals featured in the Book of RockStar Leaders—a Zubi Group initiative recognizing industry pioneers and community changemakers. Guests enjoyed a curated champagne and caviar experience, accompanied by live entertainment and sweeping waterfront views.

The evening’s distinguished guest list included television personalities Laurie Jennings and Marta Bloom; philanthropists Ana VeigaMilton and Krystyna Laukin; and respected leaders Colin Cowie, Naty Díaz, Osirys Méndez, Sabrina Vela, and Lili Somoano, representing Doral Automotive Group.

“Throughout my career, I’ve had the privilege of building, creating, and connecting across seven diverse industries, launching brands, shaping businesses, and bringing visions to life,” shared Emily Zubi, CEO of Zubi Group. “However, it’s the people—the leaders and the rock stars—who have taught me the most valuable lessons. This book is about them.”

A portion of proceeds from The Book of RockStar Leaders will support breast cancer awareness initiatives through the nonprofit Pink Luminous Advocacy Project, further reflecting the spirit of leadership and compassion that defines the publication.

FYI Yachts was honored to contribute to an evening that celebrated excellence, empowerment, and purpose within the Miami community. The event’s success was made possible through the generous collaboration of luxury partners, including Emily Zubi International, Petal Cartel, Wine 41, Casa Noosh, V2 Jets, and Mendez Vela Medal Design.

As Miami continues to serve as a hub for luxury, innovation, and philanthropy, FYI Yachts remains dedicated to curating experiences that inspire connection—both on and off the water.
